card.name: Spots where 'paper' could come next
card.fires_on: Scattered spots, often partway through a name or word, where the next word could plausibly be 'paper' or 'papers'. Examples are a period after an initial, the start of 'napkin', or a broken character in Chinese titles.

modes.label: Inside names and titles
modes.description: A period or partial piece inside a person's name, case citation or foundation name.

modes.label: Start of a split everyday word
modes.description: A first piece of a word that is split up, such as in napkin or Japanese verb forms.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward 'paper' and 'papers' and away from other word beginnings starting with p.
card.plain: It fires at scattered odd spots and nudges the model to predict the word 'paper'.
